symptom: `check -p --references` passed a flow in an app module that ran a database `retrieve … from AddOn.Internal`, a `create AddOn.Internal` or a `create list of AddOn.Internal` on a Hidden entity of a Protected (add-on) module; exec wrote it and mxbuild refused CE1406 "Retrieve object(s) activity … / Create object activity … / Create list activity … is not allowed to use entity 'AddOn.Internal' because app modules cannot reference hidden elements in add-on modules" (ako/mxcli#1699, mendixlabs/mxcli#1652).
cause: validateProtectedModuleRefs judged an entity only in a flow's signature (checkFlow → entityRef on parameter and return types); the body walk collected pages and microflows, and checkFlowMembers judged only the MEMBERS of a create or retrieve — so an activity naming nothing but the entity reached no check.
fix: checkFlowMembers (validate_protected_module_members.go) calls the existing entityRef for the entity of a CreateObjectStmt, of a database RetrieveStmt (no StartVariable) and of a CreateListStmt, inside the walkTypedFlow visitor that already runs only for flows outside the Protected module — one verdict, which check and exec's preflight both run.
insight: Enumerate the activities that NAME an element, not just the expressions that read one: CE1406 is 'any use', and the earlier fix covered members and signatures but no activity whose only reference is its entity. Measured on 11.13.0 with the module set Protected through UpdateModuleSettings (a 30-line helper; MDL cannot make a module Protected), one microflow per shape because mx check names the activity but not the document: retrieve (list, limit 1, where), create (bare, with members), create list — each refused in microflows and nanoflows, the Usable entity and in-module use clean. NOT refused, so do not add them: an association retrieve over a Usable association whose far end is Hidden, and commit/delete/count of such an object (they name no entity). A flow in ANOTHER Protected module is refused too ('add-on modules cannot reference hidden elements in add-on modules'), which the checker still skips for every shape — a sibling gap.
